tldr: Two articles shift my model, two are half-finished, one is a leaderboard novelty.

articles.what_i_would_do_with_it: Add pre-trade K% trajectory as a risk flag on our deadline pitcher board. Build a Q1-quartile (falling K%) buy list and have pro scouts validate stuff hasn't degraded.
articles.what_is_missing: Q1 buy list conditional on Stuff+ or arsenal-percentile stability — tells me whether the buy is real or a trap.
articles.honest_critique: The seller-knows-something mechanism is dominant and the article underweights it.

articles.what_i_would_do_with_it: Reweight our trade-deck scoring to elevate org-fit features (alumni network, dev fit) over prospect FV.
articles.what_is_missing: Confront the max_fv=0 prevalence head-on — the 'prospect features don't matter' finding is partly 'we don't have prospect data for most trades.'
articles.honest_critique: The methodology callout half-admits the coverage problem and the headline ignores it.

articles.what_i_would_do_with_it: Nothing yet. Wait for the payroll stratification check.
articles.what_is_missing: Run the payroll-stratified test that the article itself flags as unrun.
articles.honest_critique: Publishing a finding while flagging that the most-important confound is unchecked is a tell. Either run the check or don't publish.

articles.what_i_would_do_with_it: Interesting input to portfolio construction but I'd want to see it controlled for total acquired-WAR before changing behavior.
articles.what_is_missing: Test whether the result survives controlling for total acquired-player quality — breadth might just be a proxy for getting more players.
articles.honest_critique: Two-coefficient framing is elegant but could be one mechanism dressed as two.

articles.what_i_would_do_with_it: Nothing. I already know who Beane is.
articles.what_is_missing: Within-GM persistence is r=0.27 with a CI that crosses zero. Naming individual GMs at that signal-to-noise level is irresponsible.
articles.honest_critique: Leaderboard novelty. The decomposition piece is the actual story; this one is the clickbait shell.

cross_article_observations: Every downstream finding inherits the V3 model's calibration. The site has not shown coverage / CRPS / residuals by trade archetype anywhere I can find — I can't validate the chain.
Receiver-side framing throughout. No seller-side counterpart on any finding.
Several articles flag known confounds as unrun and publish anyway.
what_i_actually_want_to_read_next: Calibration audit of the V3 model itself — coverage, CRPS, residuals by trade archetype.
K% trajectory conditional on Stuff+ or arsenal-percentile stability — separates real Q1 buys from traps.
Pre-deadline buy-list quartile generation as a reproducible weekly artifact.
what_this_site_is_missing_entirely: In-season updates as trade rumors break
Stuff+ or pitch-level features alongside K% trajectory
